---
title: "Publications"
---
This is a list of my academic publications. It just pulls from my ORCID, and as such does not reflect any preprints, and may be behind. You can also find my publications on my google scholar [profile](https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=AEkfk_QAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate).

## Publications
```{python}
#| echo: false
import requests
from IPython.display import Markdown

orcid_id = "0000-0002-0509-2755"

url = f"https://pub.orcid.org/v3.0/{orcid_id}/works"
headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

works = response.json()["group"]
works = sorted(works, key=lambda w: w["work-summary"][0]["publication-date"]["year"]["value"] if w["work-summary"][0]["publication-date"] else "0", reverse=True)


lines = []
for work in works:
    summary = work["work-summary"][0]
    title = summary["title"]["title"]["value"]
    year = summary["publication-date"]["year"]["value"] if summary["publication-date"] else "n.d."
    journal = summary["journal-title"]["value"] if summary["journal-title"] else ""

    doi = ""
    for eid in summary.get("external-ids", {}).get("external-id", []):
        if eid["external-id-type"] == "doi":
            doi = eid["external-id-value"]
            break

    if doi:
        lines.append(f"**{title}** ({year}). *{journal}*. <https://doi.org/{doi}>")
    else:
        lines.append(f"**{title}** ({year}). *{journal}*")

Markdown("\n\n".join(lines))
```
